title.zh: 微软向约四分之一员工提供大规模买断
title.en: Microsoft offers mass buyouts for roughly a quarter of its workforce

current_state.zh: 微软向美国、加拿大、英国和印度部分部门约6万名员工（约27%）开放自愿离职，范围包括Copilot和AI体验团队，但排除部分数据中心、销售和营销岗位；这是微软今年第二次此类方案，员工需在12月初前决定并于年底离职。
current_state.en: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance to about 60,000 employees (~27%) across parts of the US, Canada, UK and India, including Copilot and AI experiences teams but excluding some datacenter, sales and marketing roles; it is the company's second such program this year, with employees deciding by early December and leaving by year-end.

updates.what_changed_en: Microsoft offered mass buyouts to roughly a quarter of its workforce, amounting to about 60,000 employees, just days after its president publicly said the company stands by its people.
